notes: A monogram surviving only as a specular foil stamp on a 2019 brochure, ten phone frames of mount points (two of the same corridor, three walls flattened to one neutral by auto-WB, three schedule facilities never photographed), four 'liked' signs that are secretly two incompatible systems, last season's fixed-measure door-plate PDF, and a 24-row bilingual schedule with over-long names, a duplicate facility and one un-fittable name.

assets.prompt: Handheld photograph of a 2019 printed brochure lying on a wooden desk, raking window light. On the uncoated cream cover a monogram is FOIL-STAMPED in metallic foil (gold-to-champagne): an interlocking I and V inside a FINE OVAL RULE, with a small palm frond at the join where the two letters cross. Because it is foil, the SAME stroke reads dark charcoal where it turns away from the light and bright NEAR-WHITE SPECULAR where it turns toward it, with the cream stock sitting in between — so no single ink value describes the mark. The monogram is stamped SMALL relative to the cover (plenty of empty cream around it), with a subtle deboss impression catching a shadow. Quiet, upscale, restrained. Slight desk grain and a soft cast shadow of the photographer.
assets.defect_engineered: foil stamp has no single ink value (specular on one flank, dark on the other; an ink-level selection returns a plausible partial with whole strokes missing and no flag); stamped small so the oval rule and interlocked counters are the first to close at reproduction size

LAYOUT DESCRIPTION (for the renderer/author of this press PDF)

Product: room / facility door plate, the file the current plates were cut from by the (now closed) 2016 sign shop. Trim 150 x 60 mm landscape, one facility per page. No bleed present and NONE can be added from this file. The existing fixings are drilled for this exact size, so trim CANNOT change.

Appearance: Deep Palm (#2C3B34) plate, Sand Cream (#EFE9DD) reversed text, a small Isla Verde monogram at the left.
  Right of the monogram: two stacked text lines — line 1 the English facility name, line 2 the Spanish facility name. A small room NUMBER sits top-right.

IMPORTANT STRUCTURE: the NAME line sits in a FIXED-MEASURE text frame sized to the LONGEST facility name the property had in 2016. A longer name does NOT spill, reflow or overset — it simply STOPS RENDERING partway through at the frame's right edge. The bilingual second (Spanish) line shares the SAME story and the SAME fixed-measure behaviour, and the two languages fail at different lengths.

FIELD CONTENT in the story, in order:
  NUMBER
  NAME (EN)
  NAME (ES)

Example values on a 2016 plate:
  NUMBER 12 | NAME (EN) Spa Reception | NAME (ES) Recepción del Spa
assets.defect_engineered: name line is a fixed-measure frame that truncates (stops drawing) instead of overrunning; the bilingual Spanish line shares the same story and truncates at a different length; no bleed and none can be introduced

assets.content:
ISLA VERDE — SIGN SHOP REQUIREMENTS
(what the new fabricator sent when we asked what they need)

SUBSTRATE AND FINISH
  Directional panels: 3 mm brushed aluminium composite, matt laminate, direct print.
  Door plates: 2 mm anodised aluminium, sub-surface print.
  Door-plate fixings are the EXISTING 2016 drilling — plate trim cannot change.

PANEL CUT SIZES (our standard cut list)
  Directional, corridor: 200 x 300 mm portrait.
  Directional, garden: 250 x 350 mm portrait, weatherised.
  Overhead / junction: 400 x 150 mm landscape.
  Door plate: 150 x 60 mm landscape (matches the 2016 plate).

TYPE — minimum legible cap height
  25 mm at 5 m viewing distance.
  18 mm at 3 m.
  Door plates read at about 0.8 m: 8 mm minimum.
  Do not set below these heights.

CLEAR SPACE
  Keep all artwork and type at least 12 mm inside the cut edge on directional panels; 6 mm on door plates.

COLOUR / FILES
  Two spot colours preferred for the etch feel. Supply vector at true physical size, monogram and symbols as closed paths.

DELIVER
  One editable document with every panel at true cut size, plus the door-plate run as one-per-page press-resolution output, plus a schedule we can work from.
assets.defect_engineered: none (clean reference: substrate, the fixed door-plate cut list, minimum legible type heights per distance, clear space)
